text_block_list.name: Ikuno & Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. I'm going for one more lap.
What about you, Tannhauser-san?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too! That mock race the other day
was sooo very close!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
This time, aiming for 1st place!
Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Next time, without fail...
Well then, another lap!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooh...! Ikuno and the others
are so cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
—So during lunchtime, I wanna praise them
super big over the school broadcast!
Everyone, help me out!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I would be delighted to join! Allow me
to bestow a musica fit for encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, I shall fully cooperate.
Those two look after me all the time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And at the same time, I can show off 'the kind,
friend-cherishing Lois-chan' on the air...! Perfect!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, quite the intense crowd we got here...
Well, can't be helped. Guess I'll pitch in too.
Gotta do it right for those two, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuu~!!
Then let's all get ready after school!!

During lunch break, while enjoying
a meal in the cafeteria—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
『Heeeeeey!!
Ikuno! Machitan! Can you hear me!?』

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Pyoeeeh!? What's going on!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san...?
Whatever is she doing—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Ikuno and Machitan
are always working super hard in training, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So we're all gonna praise them!!
Right, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's the gist of it. We heard about it from Turbo.
So we all put this together.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Turbo worked so hard making certificates of merit,
she got ink all over her hands. Here, go ahead and read it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
*ahem*! Uhh, Sir Ikuno Dictus,
Sir Matikanetannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
T-Today is in recognition of you two's daily...
Umm... how do you read this kanji again?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy. Lunch will be over at this rate.
Hand it over, I'll read it for ya.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehe~.
This is kind of embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Using the school-wide broadcast is
just so typical of Turbo-san... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*cough*.
I, Royce and Royce, also take great pride
in the daily efforts displayed by both of you.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I shall continue to look up to you as my guideposts,
for I am constantly inspired by the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Indubitably!
You are the musicistas playing an indomitable march!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Earth made
a song for you guys too!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì!
Please accept this heartfelt regalo!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us perform it!
Is everyone ready? It is time for the coro!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: One, two, three—

text_block_list.name: Turbo and Others
text_block_list.text:
Great job Ikuno~♪
Amazing Machita~n♪
(Clap, clap, clap, clap!!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehe, fuhehehehe~~.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno! Machitan!
I brought your certif-ee-cates!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Turbo-san...!
Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh!
The surprise was a huge succeeeess!!

Watching Twin Turbo and the others warmly
interact made my heart swell with emotion.
(GRUUUUMBLE~~!)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Auugh... Come to think of it,
Turbo hasn't eaten lunch yet~.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, mic off, mic off!
Your stomach growling is broadcasting to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Shall we go buy something
from the cafeteria store to thank them?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Agreed! Meals, snacks, and juices!
Loooads of everyone's favorites!!

Watching them care for their teammates
brought an involuntary smile to my face.
